responsibility: Declares the call_string data structure used to encode interprocedural call-stack context at analyzer program points. It defines the element type storing caller/callee supernode pairs, APIs for extending and inspecting stacks, comparison and validation helpers, and the child-cache layout that lets region_model_manager own and consolidate call strings as a persistent tree shared across the analysis.
same_name_distinction: Declares the call_string type, its element layout, and the child-cache/ownership structure for the persistent call-stack tree, whereas call-string.cc provides the executable logic for those operations.
